entries.finding: Galaxy cluster MACS J0717: Hubble ACS at 606 and 814 nm, with Chandra X-ray light overlaid; 3000 × 2911 px over 4.86 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.09711 arcsec per pixel, north 0.4° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 109.379778°, 37.7571709°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
